Human molecular mechanisms of lumbar disc degeneration: A scoping review

Overview of human molecular mechanisms of lumbar disc degeneration identified in the included studies of this scoping review, including metabolic dysregulation, programmed cell death, proinflammatory cytokines, regulatory proteins as epigenetic, posttranscriptional/translational regulators, and signaling pathway mediators, as well as ncRNA networks
